'''Vritol''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] that lived during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. He was a creature trainer who lived along the [[Rryatt Trail]].

==Behind the scenes==
Vritol appeared as a non-player character in the video game Star Wars Galaxies, a massively multiplayer online roleplaying game developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by LucasArts, prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].
